nodes.label: Procrastination as a pain response, not laziness
nodes.norm_label: procrastination as a pain response not laziness
nodes.summary: The whole subject of 03 - Resources/LLM Wiki/concepts/prokrastinasi.md. Defines procrastination at L10 as the habit of delaying work despite an intention to finish it, then reframes it at L14 as a biological response: looking at something unwanted activates the brain's pain-related area, and the brain looks for a way to stop that negative stimulation by diverting attention to something more pleasant (L16). The note's two prescriptions and its two stated reasons hang off that reframing.

nodes.label: Focus-Restore cycle
nodes.summary: The named four-step technique the note prescribes, under '### Siklus Fokus-Restorasi' at L20: 25 minutes of focused work with distractions off (L22), 2-5 minutes of recall (L23), 2-3 minutes of rest without a phone (L24), then repeat (L25). The note also constrains the rest step: no phone, because it pulls the brain back into focus mode, in favour of quiet rest, a short walk, or a simple non-demanding activity (L35-39).
nodes.rationale: [03 - Resources/LLM Wiki/concepts/prokrastinasi.md:L43] — the note states the reason the technique works as "Rasa tidak nyaman pada saraf **menghilang** tidak lama setelah kamu benar-benar mulai mengerjakan hal yang awalnya tidak disukai. Jadi: **mulai aja dulu!**", i.e. the discomfort goes away shortly after you actually start, which is why the prescription is 'just start'.

nodes.label: Active recall strengthens retrieval, not just storage
nodes.norm_label: active recall strengthens retrieval not just storage
nodes.summary: Step 2 of the Focus-Restore cycle, given its own heading '### Kenapa Recall Penting?' at L27. The note gives three reasons recall matters: it strengthens memory traces (L29), the information becomes easier to find again (L30), and the brain gets used to retrieving data rather than only storing it (L31). Linked from the note's Related Concepts as '[[active-recall]] — Praktik mengingat yang memperkuat pembelajaran' (L49).
nodes.rationale: [03 - Resources/LLM Wiki/concepts/prokrastinasi.md:L31] — the note's own stated reason is the bullet "Otak terbiasa \"mengambil\" data, bukan cuma \"menyimpan\"", i.e. the brain gets used to retrieving data rather than only storing it, which is why recall sits inside the focus cycle rather than after it.

nodes.label: A 404 with a completely empty body when the access-code secret is unset
nodes.norm_label: a 404 with a completely empty body when the access code secret is unset
nodes.summary: The design decision T5's report lists first under '## Decisions the spec left open' (L8187). GET on the code-login route returns status 404 with no HTML body at all, not a rendered error page, when FASTTRACK_ACCESS_CODE is unset; the tests pin the body as genuinely empty, not merely form-free (L8185, L7449). POST with the secret unset also returns 404 (L8174), and POST with no DB binding returns 500 with the existing JSON shape {"error":"db_unavailable"} and JSON_HEADERS (L8175). The access code itself appears in none of the three created files (L8182).
nodes.rationale: [05 - Conversations/home-belajarcarabelajar-proyek-fasttrack/2026-10-02 - t5-code-login-endpoint [ses_f060278dcffe2ByD1uTouCgy5f].md:L54] — the task states the reason as "The feature does not exist until configured (D7). Return a minimal response; do NOT render the form, because rendering it would advertise the fallback." The report restates the same reason at L8188: any page naming "kode akses" becomes a probe for whether the feature is configured, which D7 forbids.

nodes.label: The mock.module leak in this repo is bidirectional, so the cloudflare:workers seam fails in the full suite
nodes.norm_label: the mock module leak in this repo is bidirectional so the cloudflare workers seam fails in the full suite
nodes.summary: The finding the T5 session flags as '## One thing worth flagging to you' (L8195). Four throwaway probes under /tmp/opencode/probe showed two files each mocking the same specifier seeing their own holder regardless of order (L3596, L3629, L3645, L3667, L3676), so the obvious test shape — mock.module("cloudflare:workers") to keep the real lib/auth.ts — looked safe. It is not: logout.test.ts:41, me.test.ts:75 and callback-gate.test.ts:75 already occupy ../../../lib/auth.ts, that mock leaked into the new files through the ./code.ts import chain, and 33 of the new tests failed on the first full-suite run (L6301, L6993, L7025). The fix is a factory that closes over the already-imported real module and re-exports it with only workerRuntimeEnv replaced, so cookie assertions run against the real getSessionCookie instead of a test-local copy (L8198, L7019).
nodes.rationale: [05 - Conversations/home-belajarcarabelajar-proyek-fasttrack/2026-10-02 - t5-code-login-endpoint [ses_f060278dcffe2ByD1uTouCgy5f].md:L8196] — the stated reason the obvious seam is unusable is that "mock.module is process-wide, and logout.test.ts:41, me.test.ts:75, callback-gate.test.ts:75 already occupy ../../../lib/auth.ts with their own factories. That leaked into my files and failed 33 of them on the first full-suite run; the leak is bidirectional, not one-way."

nodes.label: A surviving mutation means a deliberate design decision is unpinned, not that coverage is low
nodes.norm_label: a surviving mutation means a deliberate design decision is unpinned not that coverage is low
nodes.summary: Ten mutations were run against the new tests; nine bit on the first pass. The tenth — the 404 rendering a real error page instead of an empty response — survived, and the response was not to accept it as a permitted variation but to add the assertion body 404 benar-benar kosong so the decision is pinned (L8185, L7449, L7457). This is the T5 session's working rule for reading a survivor: the mutant identifies a choice the test set never encoded. Distinct from the general claim that mutations prove non-vacuity.
nodes.rationale: [05 - Conversations/home-belajarcarabelajar-proyek-fasttrack/2026-10-02 - t5-code-login-endpoint [ses_f060278dcffe2ByD1uTouCgy5f].md:L7449] — the note states the reason the survivor had to be answered with a new assertion: "M9 survived. That's my deliberate design decision (empty 404 vs rendered error page), and no test covers it... my GET 404 test only asserts no <form>. I should add an assertion that the 404 body is empty, to pin the 'minimal response' decision."

nodes.label: The applyTrack else branch is a fully general give-me-a-URL-string player
nodes.norm_label: the applytrack else branch is a fully general give me a url string player
nodes.summary: The R5 audit's central seam finding and the RECOMMENDED SEAM (L8234, L8236). pomodoroMusicPlayer.ts:570-581 is a general 'give me a URL string' player: it only requires that resolveAudioSourceUrl return something assignable to audioElement.src (L574-575), then sets loop, volume and playbackRate. It performs no validation, no MIME probe, no existence check and no CORS check. Because play() :701, pause() :731, seekTo() :785 and startProgressTracking() :256 all test === "youtube" separately, and updateAudioOutputVolume :232-249 and setPlaybackRate :820-833 are already sourceType-agnostic, the entire engine diff for a Rust-provided audio URL is one conditional predicate at :558 plus an optional resolvedSourceUrl field — loop, queue advance, ended handling and fade are all inherited. Graceful degradation back to the IFrame path when extraction is unavailable keeps every other platform working (L8243); the smaller no-types.ts variant that emits sourceType: "local" is explicitly not recommended because the recent-chip re-apply at :794 would replay a stale path through detectAudioSourceType with no re-extraction and the bar would display LOCAL instead of YOUTUBE (L8246).

nodes.label: Tauri asset protocol scope is $DOWNLOAD and $APP only, so a temp-file cannot be played
nodes.norm_label: tauri asset protocol scope is download and app only so a temp file cannot be played
nodes.summary: R5 rates this the highest-probability breakage in the whole plan (L8250). tauri.conf.json:27-30 sets app.security.assetProtocol = { enable: true, scope: ["$DOWNLOAD/**", "$APP/**"] }, and R5's finding is that the binding constraint is tauri.conf.json rather than capabilities/default.json: a file outside those two subtrees cannot be loaded via http://asset.localhost/… (pomodoroMusicPlayer.ts:170) no matter how broad the fs scopes are. The repo's existing temp-audio convention is app.path().app_data_dir() (speech/audio/recorder.rs:20-24), which is outside both, and the failure is nearly silent — only the audio element's error listener surfaces 'Audio error: Failed to load audio source'. Mitigations named: write under the Downloads dir, extend the assetProtocol scope, or return a data:/blob: URL (both already CSP-allowed). Same claim as chunk-rem-097, emitted from the R5 audit of the same decision.
nodes.rationale: [05 - Conversations/home-belajarcarabelajar-proyek-snipset/2026-09-26 - r5-frontend-integration-surface [ses_f24bc0787ffem5gljiVtSZzZTX].md:L8250] — the note's own stated reason the naive extract-to-temp design fails is that "The repo's temp-audio convention is app_data_dir() (speech/audio/recorder.rs:20-24), which is outside $APP (Tauri v2 $APP = app *config* dir) and outside $DOWNLOAD. Output there yields an http://asset.localhost/… URL that the webview cannot load".

nodes.label: canPlayMimeType fails open, so it can hint but must never gate
nodes.norm_label: canplaymimetype fails open so it can hint but must never gate
nodes.summary: mediaPlayback.ts:8-20 returns true on three distinct documented conditions — no document (:9), element construction throwing (:13-15), and a missing element or missing canPlayType (:18) — and treats both "probably" and "maybe" as playable (:19), with the element memoized in a module-level cache. So it can mechanically validate an extractor-reported container MIME with kind: "audio" (L8197), but only as a hint. The consequence R5 draws is that probe results must be advisory — prefer opus, or pick a container the extractor already knows is safe — rather than used to hide the Load button, because AAC-in-MP4 on webkit2gtk depends on GStreamer libav being installed and that is exactly the case the fail-open probe cannot detect (L8198, L8252). The fail-open behaviour is pinned by mediaPlayback.test.ts:34-44. Nothing in the Pomodoro music path calls the helper today (L8197). This is the fail-open qualification of the probe, not the claim that probing beats an OS-string branch.

nodes.label: No test drives a remote sourceType through the audio element
nodes.norm_label: no test drives a remote sourcetype through the audio element
nodes.summary: The gap R5 flags when answering whether an existing audio-element test could be pattern-matched. None of the 19 installWorkingAudio() calls overrides sourceType — only loop — so every one runs makeTrack()'s sourceType: "local" default (:400-409) (L8220, L8261). PomodoroMusicBar.test.tsx does use "preset" fixtures, but with the player fully mocked (:58), so the engine never sees them. The remote-URL shape is pinned only at the resolveAudioSourceUrl unit level (:109-119, :482-488). A native extraction path returning a remote URL would therefore be the first untested case through that branch. A related harness coupling: the global setup installs window.__TAURI_INTERNALS__ (hooks/test/setup.tsx:47-55), so any new test asserting el.src must expect an asset.localhost rewrite (L8260).
